comments.author: frank
comments.body: LedgerEntry is the perfect case for Pydantic: you want amount/currency validation on every entry. A dataclass gives you nothing.

comments.author: bob
comments.body: Validation happens in `insert_balanced` (it checks the entries balance), which is the invariant that actually matters. Field-level coercion is exactly what we don't want near money.

comments.author: alice
comments.body: Dataclass per ADR-005. Frank, if you want to reopen the ADR, let's do it at the arch sync rather than in individual PRs; this is the third time (#109, #115).

threads.rejection_reason: ADR-005: domain types are frozen dataclasses; reopen the ADR at arch sync, not per PR.

comments.author: carol
comments.body: This logged `customer_email=customer_email` in the first version. Emails are PII and Datadog retention is 30 days: please `redact()` it, or better, drop it and log the refund id only.

comments.author: bob
comments.body: Good catch. Redacted; kept it for support's sake since the masked domain is still useful.

comments.author: alice
comments.body: First commit raised `HTTPException(422)` here. The ledger is called from the payout worker too, so domain error please (see #117).
